model: iNTouch BMS for iQ251 / iQ251D (software v73 and later)
applies_to: Intellihot iQ251 and iQ251D wall-hung tankless water heaters (up to 10 cascaded) with unit software v73 or later and the iNTouch BMS board.
summary: The iNTouch BMS board gives a cascade of iQ251 wall-hung heaters one BACnet IP or MS/TP interface. System-level objects carry the on/off command, the setpoint write, alarm and interface status; each unit has a block of ID, alarm, status, temperature, flow and firing-rate objects, and fault objects report which unit has each fault.
firmware: Wall-hung unit software v73 or later
notes: Unit-level objects are printed for unit 1 only. Unit 1 uses AV 12-19, unit 2 AV 20-27 and so on (8 objects per unit, up to unit 10 at AV 84-91); unit on/off bits for units 1-10 use AV 112-141 (3 per unit).
Fault objects AV 92-108 hold the number (1-10) of the unit that has that fault.
Temperatures are in °F. Unit_Flow_GPM has a scaling of 10.
Names are kept as printed, including 'Tempurature'.
The External_* AVs mirror the iNTouch relay outputs and the AIs its dry-contact inputs (1 = on).

integration.summary: Fit the iNTouch BMS board (factory or field kit), load the matching wall-hung or floor-mount config file and connect BACnet IP or MS/TP. Turn the system on/off with BV 1 and write the setpoint to AV 1 as 256 + °F. Read the active setpoint, system alarm code and per-unit temperatures.
integration.enable: BV 1 Set_ON_OFF_BACnet turns the system on (1) or off (0); default is 1. The Remote ON/OFF dry-contact input must also be closed (factory jumper).
integration.remote_sensors: A 0-10 V / 4-20 mA remote setpoint can be wired to the iNTouch board; its value reads back in Remote_Setpoint. The BMS setpoint is written to AV 1.
setup: BACnet IP: the iNTouch web page is at 192.168.1.24 by default; change the IP under Setup > Network Settings or with the FieldServer Toolbox, then restart.
BACnet MS/TP: default device ID is 111; change it if it clashes (Intellihot support helps).
Wall-hung (iQ251/iQ251D) and floor-mount models use different config files; they are not interchangeable.
One iNTouch board covers a whole cascade of units; uncascaded units each need their own board.
gotchas: Set_Temperature takes 256 + the setpoint in °F (376 = 120 °F, range 356-446); writing the plain temperature does not work.
Alarm code objects are hex-packed: thousands digit = unit/module, hundreds = extra detail, tens/ones = error code (e.g. 0A = EA open sensor).
The Remote ON/OFF and Louver Feedback inputs ship with jumpers; 'bA Off' on the display means the Remote ON/OFF jumper is missing.
